message.content:
**July 4, 1776**

On this day the Continental Congress formally adopted the *Declaration of Independence*. While the document itself was drafted earlier and many delegates did not sign until later—most signatures were affixed between **August 2–September 7, 1776**, with George Washington’s signature added in December—the official act declaring independence took place on July 4th.
